column4: The source section names root ش ر ح for opening the chest. This ayah says God opens a breast for Islam, then sets a boundary with a chest made “ضَيِّقًا حَرَجًا,” likened to climbing into heaven; the paired outcomes show both capacity and constriction, while the opening's direction is guidance.
